entries.title: Skim can keep several briefs for one article
entries.body: On an article you own, a dropdown beside 'Reading for:' in Skim lets you add, switch between, edit and delete briefs: notes of what you are reading the piece for. Each brief gets its own route through the article, and your original brief stays as the default. The app remembers which brief you were on and how far along its route, and a link to one of your added briefs opens on the default route for anyone else.
